summary: First-pass full e2e testing of MémoirePro. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass (auth, orders, files, writer, documents, AI SSE stream). Frontend: all critical flows verified end-to-end via Playwright — landing page, anonymous order submission, order tracking on /client, file upload + submit-documents (status transitions to documents_envoyes), registration -> /editeur (protected), AI chat streaming + ai-mode-outline + insert-response-btn, admin login -> /redacteur, writer key login lists orders, writer status update, mark-all, file download links, payment success page, PWA manifest.json + sw.js served with service worker registered. Two minor issues reported below.

minor.issue: allow_origins=["*"] with allow_credentials=False is fine for JWT via Authorization header, but combined with the '*' wildcard prevents future cookie-based auth. Consider explicit origins if cookies are ever adopted.

integration_issues.issue: After successful admin login the user is redirected to /redacteur, but the page always shows the writer-key entry form (component only checks localStorage 'mp_writer_key', ignoring the admin JWT). Backend already accepts admin role without key, so the dashboard should auto-load /writer/orders using the JWT when the user role is 'admin'. Currently admin must additionally enter the writer key to see orders.

issues: React Router v6 future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) - non-blocking; consider enabling future flags to silence.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Redacteur.js, when useAuth() user.role === 'admin', treat as authed and call /writer/orders without a key (backend already permits it). Currently admin is forced to type the writer key after login.
(Optional) Add v7 future flags to BrowserRouter to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 573 lines — approaching the split threshold; consider modularising (routers/auth.py, routers/orders.py, routers/writer.py, routers/ai.py) as more features land.
put_object/get_object use blocking `requests` inside async endpoints (upload/download). Under load this will block the event loop; consider httpx.AsyncClient or running in a threadpool.
OrderInput.email is stored lowercased (good) but `document_type`/`academic_level` are free strings with no whitelist — future writer dashboard reporting may be affected.
Admin bootstrap in startup() properly re-hashes the password if changed — good idempotent seed.
bcrypt hash format confirmed ($2b$) via login-success on admin credentials.
test_credentials: Admin admin@memoirepro.africa / admin123 (works). Writer access key: redacteur-memoirepro-2026 (works). File /app/memory/test_credentials.md missing.
seed_data_creation: Multiple test users (email test_<rand>@example.com / secret123 and user_<rand>@test.com / secret123). Several anonymous orders were created and one transitioned to documents_envoyes + en_cours during writer test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, junit at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). To reproduce, run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview_url> pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. AI streaming test hits Claude Sonnet 4.6 and can take up to 30s. The admin->redacteur auto-load issue is the only functional gap.
rca of the issue: Redacteur.js component only trusts localStorage 'mp_writer_key' to decide authed state. It does not inspect AuthContext, so admins logging in via /connexion land on a page that still asks for the writer key. Fix: in useEffect check user?.role==='admin' from useAuth() and setAuthed(true) with accessKey='' (or send Authorization header and drop key).
